description: issue #679 (SP7): the OFF half of the struct-constructor reserved-word gate — the same three `struct` definitions check clean under `core-language` + `data` alone, because the shipped checker treats `tell`/`ask`/`each` as reserved only once `sprites` is active. SCOPE, CORRECTED: maintainer ruling #833 retracted that gate. `spec/grammar.md:408` makes profile words built-in names unconditionally -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- and issue #855 aligned `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154` with it, so a conforming 0.4.0 implementation must raise `ol-reserved-word` on all three of these `struct` declarations with or without the profile. This fixture therefore pins SHIPPED BEHAVIOUR the spec now contradicts, and is kept red-flagged rather than deleted so the behaviour is not silently unpinned; issue #841 lands the always-on built-in-names list and flips this expectation. Its ON twin `reserved-struct-with-sprites` is unaffected by the ruling, because `struct` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots.
